messages:
emi.k: Quick ask  I have 28h unused from the year-end shutdown. I already have 16h carried from last year, so that'd put me at 44h which is 4h over the 40h cap. I had to extend family travel unexpectedly. Manager approved the time but asked if People Ops can make a one-time carryover exception.
hr-bot: Policy reminder: standard carryover cap is 40h. Exceptions are possible but require People Ops approval + manager justification. See: https://redwood.company/policies/pto#carryover-exceptions
fiona_mgr: I approved Emi's PTO. Context: family emergency forced extra days; Emi's role made it costly to cancel travel. I support a one-time exception for up to 8h. Adding note in Lattice: "Manager supports 1x carryover exception due to documented family emergency; employee to confirm plan for using hours in Q1."
olivia-peopleops: Thanks Fiona. Process: we need the manager note (done), employee sign-off email acknowledging this is a one-time exception and the hours must be used by Mar 31 of next year or they'll be forfeited. Also need payroll timing: cutoff for tagging exceptions is Dec 18 to avoid off-cycle. If deadline missed we can still do manual post-payroll adjustment.
caleb.payroll: Operational note: if we receive the signed consent and tag the request by Dec 18 we'll batch-post on Jan 3 and no off-cycle needed. For manual adjustments after payroll that becomes Jan 12 off-cycle and may delay the balance by a pay period. Also confirm whether exception is "additional carryover" vs "encashment" so we set the correct pay code.
emi.k: I emailed consent to Fiona + Olivia just now: "I accept the one-time 4h exception and agree to use hours by Mar 31." Hope that works.
olivia-peopleops: Got the email. I'll create an internal exception record and tag the HRIS entry as `carryover_one_time_exception`. We'll also add an audit note with the manager text.
hr-bot: people-ops ticket created: #PO-99991  olivia-peopleops assigned. Link: https://redwood.company/people-ops/tickets/PO-99991
caleb.payroll: Tagged for Jan 3 batch. We'll post 44h to Emi's balance on Jan 3 (4h marked as one-time exception with expiry 2026-03-31). If Emi prefers encashment instead, we need final election by Dec 22.
fiona_mgr: Thanks team. Emi  please ping me if travel changes and we can revisit.
emi.k: Appreciate it everyone  thank you for the quick help. Closing loop when I see the Jan balance.
